evidence.text: Can an inflationary epoch of high-scale confinement implement early axion relaxation in SU(5), suppressing later coherent misalignment enough to remove the conventional cosmological upper bound on today's axion decay constant in KSVZ, DFSZ and gauge-axion realizations?

sources.title: Heterotic String Theory Suggests a QCD Axion Near 0.5 neV

evidence.text: Does the heterotic model-independent axion impose a QCD-axion mass floor near 0.5 neV, how often can model-dependent axions shift that mass, and are the resulting PQ quality and heavy-axion cosmology viable?

sources.title: A scaling non-compact QCD axion

evidence.text: Can a runaway exponential potential dynamically erase inflationary QCD-axion isocurvature before QCD, while yielding viable dark matter and acceptable residual strong-CP violation?

sources.title: Technically Natural Baryogenesis with the QCD Axion

evidence.text: Can QCD-axion dynamics account simultaneously for strong CP relaxation, the baryon asymmetry and dark matter using technically natural ingredients, while preserving axion quality and avoiding excessive relic abundance?

sources.title: Supersymmetry, axions and cosmology

evidence.text: How do supersymmetric axion partners change cosmological bounds on the QCD axion decay constant, and when do generic light pseudoscalar moduli create additional cosmological problems?

sources.title: String compactification, QCD axion and axion-photon-photon coupling

evidence.text: Can a phenomenologically viable heterotic compactification supply a QCD axion with an experimentally accessible decay constant, after imposing realistic Yukawa couplings, hidden-sector confinement and axion mixing? What axion-photon-photon coupling follows?

sources.title: Probing a QCD string axion with precision cosmological measurements

evidence.text: Can primordial gravitational waves, together with CMB isocurvature and non-Gaussianity bounds, test a string/M-theory QCD axion without fixing its initial misalignment, dark-matter fraction, or allowed late-particle entropy dilution?

sources.title: Inflation models with Peccei–Quinn symmetry and axion kinetic misalignment

evidence.text: Can DFSZ-type PQ inflation generate the initial axion velocity needed for kinetic misalignment while preserving axion quality, reheating successfully, stabilizing the Higgs fields and keeping PQ symmetry broken after reheating?

sources.title: Dark energy, QCD axion, BICEP2, and trans-Planckian decay constant

evidence.text: Identify accidental global symmetries from a restricted superpotential, such as its dimension-three terms, while the full superpotential respects the exact discrete symmetries and contains higher-order global-symmetry violations.

sources.title: Axions, strong and weak CP, and KNP inflation

evidence.text: Computes the two-axion mass matrix and its eigenvalues, then expands near αδ−βγ=0 to identify the light inflationary direction and its enhanced effective decay constant.

sources.title: High-Scale Axions without Isocurvature from Inflationary Dynamics

evidence.text: Explicit-breaking models are studied through their induced axial and radial masses, residual strong CP violation, and corrections ΔV to inflaton slow-roll parameters. Illustrative scans cover S^N, IS^N, and multiple PQ fields; SUSY-breaking spurions test whether dangerous operators return.

sources.title: Ultralight axion in supersymmetry and strings and cosmology at small scales

evidence.text: The authors minimize superpotential F-terms, isolate symmetric and antisymmetric multiplets, and examine soft supersymmetry-breaking contributions. String examples use the N=1 supergravity potential, canonical normalization and a perturbative expansion of the corrected Kähler potential.

sources.title: Axions and ALPs: a very short introduction

evidence.text: Review anomalous chiral rotations, instanton-induced vacuum energy, and chiral perturbation theory. The dilute-instanton cosine and the zero-temperature chiral potential are explicitly distinguished; temperature-dependent masses are described using QCD topological susceptibility.

sources.title: Axion Isocurvature Perturbations in Low-Scale Models of Hybrid Inflation

evidence.text: Tree-level SUGRA potentials are supplemented by Coleman–Weinberg waterfall-sector corrections, calculated in rigid global SUSY while neglecting gravitational loop corrections. Slow-roll ε and η determine the scalar amplitude and spectral index.

sources.title: A Holographic Perspective on the Axion Quality Problem

evidence.text: Can a holographic composite axion retain its QCD coupling while sufficiently suppressing gravitational PQ violation through separation between an IR-localized axion and UV sources of explicit breaking?

sources.title: Strong-$CP$ with and without gravity

evidence.text: Does coupling QCD to gravity turn strong CP from a naturalness puzzle into a consistency condition requiring an exact axion mechanism, and can a gauge formulation protect that mechanism without a global Peccei–Quinn symmetry?

sources.title: Diluting the inflationary axion fluctuation by a stronger QCD in the early Universe

evidence.text: Can supersymmetric axion models accommodate high-scale primordial inflation, sufficiently small axion isocurvature, and axions constituting all dark matter through an early period of stronger QCD?

sources.title: Irrational axions as a solution of the strong CP problem in an eternal universe

evidence.text: Can an irrationally coupled heavy axion screen the QCD θ angle without a massless particle, and can the resulting vacuum selection operate in a universe that has been cool for only a finite time?

sources.title: Cosmic string in Abelian-Higgs model with enhanced symmetry — Implication to the axion domain-wall problem

evidence.text: Do three-dimensional reconnection and bridge formation prevent suppression of strings with multiple physical-NG windings, and can the resulting network support an axion model without a domain-wall problem?

sources.title: Impact of First-order Electroweak Phase Transition on QCD Axion

evidence.text: Can a temporary axion-mass contribution associated with a first-order electroweak transition change misalignment dynamics enough to obtain QCD-axion dark matter over a wider decay-constant range, while producing a potentially detectable gravitational-wave signal?

sources.title: Do We Live in the Swampland?

evidence.text: The QCD axion dynamically relaxes the strong CP angle. The paper asks whether the periodic potential needed for this mechanism is compatible with a derivative bound on the full potential when quintessence is its only light spectator.

sources.title: Axions In String Theory

evidence.text: Which string compactifications yield an axion coupling scale compatible with conventional cosmology, while sufficiently suppressing non-QCD violations of its Peccei–Quinn symmetry?

sources.title: Axions from Strings: the Attractive Solution

evidence.text: Does the post-inflationary axion-string network approach an initial-condition-independent attractor, and which network and emission properties permit reliable extrapolation to the QCD-era axion abundance?

sources.title: Gravity, Superselection Rules and Axions

evidence.text: Can coupling to quantum gravity turn a superselection parameter into a local field's vacuum expectation value? The proposed example is the QCD θ parameter and its promotion to an axion.

sources.title: Do We Live in the Swampland?

evidence.text: Can a rolling hidden QCD amplitude supply the missing axion slope while avoiding a direct visible-nucleon force? The construction uses a shared axion and aligned visible and mirror cosine potentials.

sources.title: Axion Quality in Warped Extra-Dimension

evidence.text: How do warping, orbifold boundary conditions, and fixed-point interactions control non-QCD potentials of a Wilson-line QCD axion? The stated natural quality target is VHE≲10⁻¹⁰mπ²fπ² for generic misalignment of the non-QCD minimum.

sources.title: Extra-dimensional axion expectations

evidence.text: What would measuring an extra-dimensional axion decay constant reveal about axion string tensions and the fundamental quantum-gravity cutoff, and how does this scenario differ phenomenologically from four-dimensional PQ models?

sources.title: String Axiverse

evidence.text: Conditional on a string QCD axion solving strong CP naturally, should many additional ultralight axions exist, and how could cosmological observations and rotating black holes reveal their masses and couplings?

sources.title: High-quality Axion Strings from Monopole Strings

evidence.text: Can extra-dimensional Wilson-line axions retain high quality while acquiring solitonic strings with tensions parametrically below quantum gravity, enabling post-inflationary axion dark matter?

sources.title: A common origin for the QCD axion and sterile neutrinos from $SU(5)$ strong dynamics

evidence.text: Can one chiral strong sector provide a high-quality composite QCD axion and sterile neutrinos, connecting PQ breaking to active-neutrino masses through either heavy composite states or light elementary–composite mixtures?

sources.title: Axion theory and model building

evidence.text: How does the ultraviolet origin of QCD axions and lighter axion-like particles determine their low-energy couplings, and could measured masses and couplings distinguish those origins?

sources.title: Strong CP and the QCD axion lecture notes via effective field theory

evidence.text: How does chiral EFT encode QCD topology, vacuum alignment and strong CP observables, and how do axions, orientifold theories and proposed phase-alignment prescriptions modify this description?

sources.title: Axionic domain wall number related to U(1)$_{\rm anom}$ global symmetry

evidence.text: Can an intermediate-scale QCD axion inherited from an anomalous string U(1) simultaneously address gravitational spoil of PQ symmetry and the cosmological domain-wall problem, despite an apparently large anomaly-related vacuum multiplicity?

sources.title: Exploring CP violation beyond the Standard Model and the PQ quality with electric dipole moments

evidence.text: Can nucleon, nuclear and atomic EDM patterns distinguish light-quark or gluon CEDMs from the QCD θ-term, with and without the PQ mechanism, and identify whether the axion vacuum value originates from CEDMs or additional UV PQ breaking?

sources.title: Axion dark matter with not quite black hole domination

evidence.text: How does a pre-BBN epoch dominated by primordial 2-2-holes alter misalignment-produced QCD axion dark matter, and what restrictions follow for the initial hole population and remnant mass when remnants supply only a small DM fraction?

sources.title: The anomalous shift of the weak boson mass and the quintessence electroweak axion

evidence.text: Can a complex, zero-hypercharge SU(2)L triplet that accounts for the CDF-era W-mass shift also increase the electroweak-instanton axion potential enough to supply dark energy, while preserving axion quality and acceptable initial conditions?

sources.title: Precision axion physics with running axion couplings

evidence.text: Can precision measurements of photon, nucleon and electron couplings distinguish light string-theoretic axions from KSVZ-like and DFSZ-like axions after RG evolution, including a possible supersymmetric extension below the axion decay constant?

sources.title: Axion RG flows and the holographic dynamics of instanton densities

evidence.text: Can the axion endpoint prescription be derived beyond specific string constructions, and does it survive explicit nonperturbative shift breaking? Can running theta be constrained in QCD-like theories or supply useful vacuum branches in self-tuning models?

sources.title: Axion-Higgs Unification

evidence.text: Can scalar-free strong dynamics unify the Higgs and QCD axion as composite pseudo-Nambu–Goldstone bosons at Λ ∼ 10^11 GeV, while accommodating fermion masses, a small high-scale Higgs quartic and potentially gauge-coupling unification?

sources.title: Search for QCD Axions in light of String Theory

evidence.text: Can string compactification and dark dimension arguments narrow the QCD axion decay constant enough to motivate targeted searches using hydrogen atomic transitions or laboratory laser interferometry?

sources.title: QCD axion dark matter in the dark dimension

evidence.text: Can resonant conversion from an axion-like particle supply the missing QCD axion dark matter abundance when the dark dimension scenario restricts the QCD axion decay constant to approximately 10^9–10^10 GeV?

sources.title: Testing F-theory GUTs with the Axiverse

evidence.text: Does the QCD-axion-like bound on photon coupling divided by mass survive F-theory GUT breaking by hypercharge flux, which introduces photon-coupled axions without gluon couplings?

sources.title: QCD, Flavor, and the de Sitter Swampland

evidence.text: What QCD vacuum structure is calculable with light composite fields? Leading-order chiral dynamics describes N light flavors while masses and θ vary, subject to confinement and the stated spontaneous chiral-symmetry-breaking pattern.

sources.title: Axionic strings, domain walls, and baryons

evidence.text: Can conserved charge on axionic strings prevent complete decay of walls bounded by those strings even when the anomaly coefficient is one, and can the surviving charged disks describe single-flavor baryons?

sources.title: Axions and the strong CP problem in M theory

evidence.text: Under what compactification and hidden-sector conditions can string axions solve strong CP in the M-theory limit, with non-QCD PQ breaking satisfying δV ≲ 10^-9 fπ²mπ² ≈ 10^-13 GeV⁴, while remaining phenomenologically and cosmologically viable?

sources.title: QCD, Flavor, and the de Sitter Swampland

evidence.text: Can an evolving scalar satisfy the conjecture on a would-be QCD false branch while preserving an acceptable present ground-branch universe? Additive sequestering and direct QCD coupling are treated separately.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Does a gravitationally generated axion harmonic preserve the QCD axion's cancellation of strong CP? The reviewed model compares a QCD cosine minimized at zero with a second cosine of the same period and a generic relative phase.

sources.title: Limits on a CP-violating scalar axion-nucleon interaction

evidence.text: Do separate scalar-force and stellar-cooling bounds constrain scalar–pseudoscalar coupling products more strongly than direct monopole–dipole searches, and what sensitivity do they imply for CP-violating QCD-axion interactions?

destinations.title: Can approximate global symmetries descending from string-compatible discrete symmetries account for dark energy, QCD-axion dark matter and inflation, including a trans-Planckian effective decay constant?
How do pseudoscalars, approximate global symmetries and underlying discrete gauge symmetries enter the QCD axion, strong and weak CP violation, dark-sector cosmology and KNP inflation?

Can inflationary modifications of the PQ sector reconcile high-scale QCD axion dark matter with observable primordial tensors, while preserving strong CP cancellation, inflationary dynamics, and a consistent subsequent cosmology?

Can supersymmetric and string models generate a non-QCD axion of mass 10^-21–10^-22 eV through the electroweak hierarchy, while accommodating moduli stabilization, a viable weak scale and dark matter production?

How do the QCD axion and more general axion-like particles arise, acquire masses and Standard Model couplings, populate the Universe, and produce observable particle or gravitational signatures? This is a short pedagogical review.

Can supersymmetric F-term and D-term hybrid inflation accommodate preinflationary QCD-axion dark matter while satisfying axion-isocurvature, scalar-CMB and cosmic-string constraints, and what restrictions follow for couplings and the gravitino mass?

Can hidden-sector instanton densities, coupled to the Standard Model through heavy messengers, generate emergent axions, and when can their masses, interactions and dynamics support a QCD axion or other cosmological roles?

Can an M-theory-inspired ultralight axion supply all dark matter while a separate QCD axion solves strong CP, without the usual overproduction at GUT-scale decay constants, and with testable couplings or residual CP violation?

When does identifying the ultraviolet cutoff of a logarithmically divergent axion EFT loop with f_a reproduce a complete QCD axion model, particularly for K⁺→π⁺a? Can a renormalizable model realize the large logarithm without additional states below the PQ scale?

Can an economical extension of the Standard Model produce an invisible QCD axion while breaking physical PQ symmetry far below the usual axion decay-constant scale, potentially near the weak scale, without a domain-wall problem?
Can a high-quality closed-string QCD axion coexist with inflation, reheating and acceptable axionic dark radiation in an LVS cosmology?

How does the higher-dimensional form-field origin of axions change their UV sensitivity, the QCD axion quality problem, and the relation between decay constants and observable matter couplings? Quality includes both maintaining a sufficiently small effective strong-CP angle and preserving the usual QCD-generated axion mass relation.

Can a post-inflation QCD axion simultaneously solve the quality problem, eliminate domain walls, and avoid unacceptable relics and low Standard Model Landau poles, while retaining conventional axion dark-matter predictions?

Can a QCD axion solving the strong CP problem satisfy observations in a theory with one micron-scale extra dimension, and how do its predictions differ between localization on the Standard Model brane and propagation in the five-dimensional bulk?

Can DFSZ-type PQ inflation generate the initial axion velocity needed for kinetic misalignment while preserving axion quality, reheating successfully, stabilizing the Higgs fields and keeping PQ symmetry broken after reheating?
Can a large scalar nonminimal coupling generate gauge-coupling thresholds and enhanced small instantons, changing QCD axion quality, mass and inflationary cosmology?

Can a gauge-protected axion in a warped extra dimension form a cosmological string network despite having no explicit PQ scalar, and how do its string profile, tension and first-order formation mechanism affect expectations for axion dark matter?
How strongly do grand unification and proton stability constrain the QCD axion mass when the axion descends from a higher-dimensional gauge field?

Can a quantized axion mass switch from large during inflation to exactly zero afterward, relaxing pre-inflation QCD axion isocurvature constraints while preserving late-time strong-CP relaxation and misalignment dark matter?

How does QCD topological susceptibility establish the physicality of θ, how can a gauge two-form eliminate θ-vacua with exact axion quality, and does its string–wall structure imply fundamental strings?

Can an inflationary epoch of high-scale confinement implement early axion relaxation in SU(5), suppressing later coherent misalignment enough to remove the conventional cosmological upper bound on today's axion decay constant in KSVZ, DFSZ and gauge-axion realizations?

Does the heterotic model-independent axion impose a QCD-axion mass floor near 0.5 neV, how often can model-dependent axions shift that mass, and are the resulting PQ quality and heavy-axion cosmology viable?
Can a runaway exponential potential dynamically erase inflationary QCD-axion isocurvature before QCD, while yielding viable dark matter and acceptable residual strong-CP violation?

Can QCD-axion dynamics account simultaneously for strong CP relaxation, the baryon asymmetry and dark matter using technically natural ingredients, while preserving axion quality and avoiding excessive relic abundance?
How do supersymmetric axion partners change cosmological bounds on the QCD axion decay constant, and when do generic light pseudoscalar moduli create additional cosmological problems?

Can a phenomenologically viable heterotic compactification supply a QCD axion with an experimentally accessible decay constant, after imposing realistic Yukawa couplings, hidden-sector confinement and axion mixing? What axion-photon-photon coupling follows?

Can primordial gravitational waves, together with CMB isocurvature and non-Gaussianity bounds, test a string/M-theory QCD axion without fixing its initial misalignment, dark-matter fraction, or allowed late-particle entropy dilution?
